subject: NovaCare discovery: SLOs, model requirements & topology — post-call recap
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@novacare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaCare discovery: SLOs, model requirements & topology — post-call recap

Hi Lena (and team),

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery focused on the inference surface and what success looks like for Novacare. High-level items we captured: 

- Primary pain: production latency spikes during peak claims-processing windows (09:00–12:00 and 20:00–22:00 PST) causing downstream job backlogs.
- Goal: consistent 95th percentile latency <= 150ms for single-turn text classification & ~250ms for multi-turn summarization at expected peak concurrency (~1.2k concurrent requests).
- Models under consideration: distilled LLaMA-2 13B for classification, fine-tuned LLaMA-2 70B (Q4 candidate) for summarization; potential to use a quantized 8-bit variant for cost tradeoffs.
- Desired topology: hybrid approach — Redwood Dedicated pool (primary) in us-west with a fallback hosted endpoint in us-east for failover and capacity overflow.

Open technical constraints you called out: encrypted KV cache for PHI-adjacent prefixes, customer-managed VPC peering for Private deployment pilot, and retention limits for audit logs (90 days).

Next steps we agreed on: 
1) Rishi: share an SLO matrix + rough cost deltas for 13B vs 70B (attached).
2) Marissa: prepare deployment sketch with autoscale knobs and estimated GPU count for peak concurrency.
3) Lena: share anonymized sample payload distribution (size, typical token lengths, and concurrency heatmap) and SOC-2 evidence owner contact.

Attachments: novacare_slo_matrix.xlsx (worksheet with latency targets and cost rows), novacare-deploy-sketch.png (high-level topology).

If anything above misses the mark, flag it and I’ll update. Proposed follow-up: technical deep-dive call w/ infra + security next Wed 06/07 at 10am PT — does that still work?

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Lena Park <lena.park@novacare.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Novacare Technical Team <infra@novacare.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Jun 2028 17:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaCare discovery: SLOs, model requirements & topology — post-call recap

Thanks Rishi — solid summary, appreciate the clear action items. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 1.2k concurrent number is our burst estimate across all product endpoints; sustained concurrency usually sits at ~400.
- The biggest risk is cold-start cost when a node pool scales from 0 -> N during morning spikes; would like to see a warm-warm strategy or pre-warm thresholds.
- For the summarization model, we are still evaluating 70B vs a 33B custom fine-tune; cost matters but we need to preserve medical term fidelity.

We’ll share the sample payloads and a short compliance contact (SOC-2 owner) by EOD Monday. Wed 06/07 10am PT works for the deep-dive.

Also: can you include a short note on our expected KV cache TTLs and whether Redwood can isolate KV namespaces per customer with encryption-in-transit and at-rest? That’s a hard requirement.

Best,
Lena

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@novacare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaCare discovery: SLOs, model requirements & topology — post-call recap

Lena — great notes, thanks. Quick answers inline below and a couple additions.

- Burst vs sustained: we’ll size two scenarios in the matrix (sustained 400, burst 1.2k) and show steady-state vs warm-start cost.
- Cold starts: Redwood Dedicated supports warm pools and a configurable minimum replica count; Marissa will sketch pre-warm thresholds and a recommended autoscale policy (concurrency-based + queue latency trigger).
- Model fidelity: for medical terminology we recommend validating the 33B fine-tune in an eval harness first; if results are within tolerance we can recommend the smaller model + quantization. We’ll include a small eval plan in the doc.
- KV cache: yes — per-customer namespaces, TLS for in-transit, AES-256 at-rest; we will call out TTL config per-route (default 24h, adjustable to meet your 90-day maximum retention requirement).

Attached updated SLO matrix has two tabs (sustained vs burst) and a column with estimated monthly token/GPU costs. To keep the meeting focused, proposed agenda for Wed: 
1) Quick alignment on sample payloads + compliance handoff (10 mins)
2) Topology walkthrough: Dedicated pool sizing, warm pool policy, failover (20 mins)
3) Model plan: eval approach for 33B vs 70B + quantization tradeoffs (15 mins)
4) Ops & audit: KV namespace encryption, log retention, and support SLAs (15 mins)

If that agenda looks good I’ll send the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rishi

[attachment: novacare_slo_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Prep notes for Wed deep-dive w/ Novacare (10am PT)

Marissa / Sean — internal prep before the call: 

1) Marissa: please convert the deploy sketch into a slide with the following labeled: primary Dedicated pool (us-west), failover hosted (us-east), warm-pool min replicas, autoscale policy examples (CPU/GPU utilization and queue-latency triggers), and a guess at GPU types (A10G vs H100 for 70B).
2) Sean: bring the KV-encryption & audit retention summary (short bullet slide) and be ready to answer vault/KMS options (we must show customer-managed KMS flow).
3) Rishi (me): I’ll open with a 3-slide SLO tradeoff summary (sustained vs burst) and have cost-delta rows for 13B/33B/70B.

Also, I put a draft doc in our shared drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b-novacare-discovery — add any technical notes by EOD Monday so we can finalize the pack.

Thanks — see you on Wed.

Rishi
